decisions.reason: Close to the established service portfolio, premium support likely meets or exceeds aspirations and reinforces customer retention, so there is little pressure to drop it.
As a tool building on existing technical capabilities, its results are probably near aspiration and it can be kept while search focuses on improving rather than eliminating it.
Distant from the firm's core hosting and management operations, this product likely falls below aspirations, prompting problemistic search and reallocation of resources to the established business.
As the flagship scalable hosting line aligned with the firm's strategic direction, its shortfalls would be tolerated and supported by slack because of its importance to future growth.
